entities.name: Emmeline Pankhurst
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: British political activist (1858-1928) who led the suffragette movement as founder of the Women's Social and Political Union. Her militant tactics — hunger strikes, property destruction, mass demonstrations — generated enormous controversy but ultimately contributed to British women gaining the vote in 1918.
